fields.Goal: Keep the sea lanes open and the salvage law enforced

blocks.text: The closest thing the Reach has to a navy: grey-cloaked wardens who patrol the drowned quarter, license salvage, and hang wreckers. Founded after [[The Drowning War]] to stop the looting of the dead kingdom — these days they mostly tax it.
Their garrison in [[Port Vellen]] holds the harbor chain. Warden-Commander Tal has chased [[Kestrel Vane]] for a decade and privately respects her more than her own quartermasters.
